Definition: from G1722 and G5117; a resident:--of that place.
BiblicalUsage: The people of that place — the residents of Caesarea — joined Paul's companions in begging him not to go up to Jerusalem in Acts 21:12, when they heard what waited for him there.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe love tries to protect us from the road God has set, and Paul's refusal to be persuaded is the measure of a man who knows where he must go.
